description: This file implements type checking and sanitization functions for a VSS (Vehicle Signal Specification) database, including numeric, boolean, enum, and array types, with validation against metadata definitions.

classes.name: VssDatabase
classes.description: Class providing methods to validate and sanitize data types according to VSS metadata.

methods.name: checkNumTypes
methods.description: Template function to check numeric types for bounds and validity.

methods.name: checkBoolType
methods.description: Function to validate boolean values represented as strings.

methods.name: checkEnumType
methods.description: Function to validate enum values against allowed options.

methods.name: checkArrayType
methods.description: Function to validate array types by checking each element.

methods.name: checkAndSanitizeType
methods.description: Main function to validate and sanitize a value based on its metadata.
